title: give the gate a focused test command with one test per command, so it never needs a regex alternation that the read-only allowlist denies

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-163301-8662, project ork, item S563:

give the gate a focused test command with one test per command, so it never needs a regex alternation that the read-only allowlist denies

Evidence: go test -run A|B was denied as multiple operations
